mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) predicts stronger corporate earnings growth, driving up equity valuations and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% in the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 1.0% in the next month, investors anticipate higher interest costs, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises above 1.0% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) strengthens economic momentum, boosting equity valuations and 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 growth and UNRATE decline are not both upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in CPIAUCSL below 5.0 triggers expectations of monetary easing, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive in late-cycle expansion periods when CPIAUCSL does not fall below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in UNRATE above 5.0% signals weakening labor demand, reducing corporate profits and causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE does not rise above 5.0% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of rising supply growth (INDPRO) and falling monetary rates (FEDFUNDS) creates dual expansionary pressures, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO growth and FEDFUNDS decline are not both upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession recovery regime, a drop in UNRATE below 4.0% indicates improving labor market conditions, prompting equity market optimism and positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive in recession recovery periods when UNRATE does not drop below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic expansion, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 and INDPRO growth do not both rise significantly.
